full_prompt:
Create exactly ONE new original Small Seal script glyph based on the attached four-specimen Unicode reference. THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC are all variants of THE SAME ONE CHARACTER, not separate output characters. Compare ALL available specimens equally to understand the exact identity. Choose ONE coherent attested WHOLE construction if variants differ; never splice incompatible alternatives or default to THX alone. Do not substitute a modern Chinese character.

Trace genuine writing-stroke trajectories as smooth controlled centerline curves. Draw these with exactly CONSTANT uniform thickness approximately 3% of the square canvas width, perfectly rounded caps and joins. No swelling, taper, pointed tips, brush pressure, serif, texture or outline of brush silhouettes. Keep essential branches, short marks, counters, attachments, separations and relative bar lengths explicit. Important small gaps must stay open.

ONE finished glyph centered in the central 70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. Pure BLACK strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background. No text, labels, charts, grids, frame, four variants, reference copies, shadows, paper, backdrop, ornament or watermark. The structural reading aid below guides attention, while all four reference specimens remain the visual authority.

CHARACTER U+3D047. Detailed reading aid: This is a complex compound glyph: compare all four, then choose the coherent OPEN THX whole construction, retaining all its detached pieces instead of borrowing merged QJZ/DYC/CCZ contacts. LEFT UPPER: one larger winding reverse-S with THREE horizontal levels; inside its upper bend a small ⊃ openLEFT and inside its lower bend a small ⊂ openRIGHT. Each small return has TWO visibly separate parallel legs and one rounded U-turn, not a dash. All three upper-left paths detached. LEFT LOWER: TWO separate horizontals (lower clearly LONGER) below that winding group, then THREE separate long gently wavy descending strokes below them; all three wavy strokes are DETACHED from both bars in this chosen whole form. RIGHT TOP: a short upright at LEFT joins TWO right-facing horizontal arms, a shorter upper arm and longer lower arm, with a short upright tip above the upper arm. RIGHT MIDDLE: a detached tall rounded oval divided by exactly TWO horizontal bars, giving exactly THREE stacked enclosed counters. Beside/under that oval is a separate supporting L-shaped stroke (long left upright then rightward floor) with TWO curved outward legs attached underneath its floor; preserve the floor and BOTH legs, and keep the oval detached from support. RIGHT BOTTOM: a separate descending central stroke curves/sweeps to the lower-right. TWO left-facing slanting crossbars intersect it. Their right sides are joined by one rounded hooked turn, enclosing exactly ONE small counter on the right of the central stem; both crossbars have distinct free LEFT ends, and the right hooked turn has a short upper tip. Total FOUR counters:3inmiddleoval+1inlower-rightcrossedhook. Preserve every subcomponent, upper-left smallreturns, all3leftwavydescenders, bothsupportlegs andlower-righttail. No invented connectors.
For this dense glyph use a consistent2.7%canvas stroke and generous clear channels so all counters and separate return legs remain legible.
